Coaching Retreat

Maintaining balance and a sense of direction in a world of change is difficult.

Yet, we strive to do so because a sense of direction toward a meaningful goal may be the better part of happiness. 

"Real power comes by doing what you are meant to be doing, and doing it well."

As we bid farewell to 2024 and enter a new year, we are thrilled to present the CMA Year End virtual conference, “The Path to Fulfillment.”

This is not your typical conference; it is a one-of-a-kind opportunity in your personal development journey,

designed to inspire you to live a more meaningful and fulfilling life.

Key Takeaways:

1. Transform Challenges into Growth Opportunities

☞ Explore how daily challenges can be seen as opportunities for personal growth.

☞ Discover effective strategies for facing difficulties with resilience, transforming them into stepping stones on your personal development journey.

2. Distinguishing a Career from a Calling

☞ Discover the fundamental differences between building a career and uncovering your true calling.

☞ Learn how to align your professional life with your passions and values, striking a powerful balance between financial stability and personal fulfilment.

☞ Apply the Life-Purpose System to uncover your hidden calling.

"Faith is the courage to live as if everything that happens, and every choice we make, is for our highest good and learning."

The virtual conference comprises 2 sessions, each 2 hours.

It will be held in 5 timeslots, and different Faculty teams will present it.

Heart Intelligence is an emerging concept referring to the flow of intuitive awareness, understanding, and inner guidance we experience when the mind and emotions are coherently aligned with the heart.

It represents a higher level of consciousness that can provide insight, creative solutions, and transformative breakthroughs.

Dr Ben Koh will explore this powerful and inspiring concept at the conference, providing insights into the intricate relationship

between our cognitive processes and our heart's intuitive wisdom through various learning activities, keynote speeches, masterclasses, and real-life coaching case studies.

You will gain insights into practical techniques for bridging the gap between analytical thinking and intuitive knowing,

learning how to harness the power of mind and heart for optimal personal growth.

What You Can Expect to Learn?

☄ A deeper understanding of the physiological and energetic connections between the heart and brain and how this knowledge can be applied to enhance personal well-being and coaching mastery.

☄ Practical tools and techniques for cultivating heart intelligence, including methods to achieve greater coherence between thoughts, emotions, and physical states.

☄ Strategies for integrating heart intelligence into daily life to foster more compassionate, intuitive, and effective decision-making processes.

CMA Retreat 2024

This retreat leads us into the inner world of our leadership and shows how we can reconnect with the deeper theme of our journey as a gateway to contribute meaningfully to the world. Reconnecting with our core intention is vital as we embark on our leadership journey. It serves as a compass, guiding us towards our deepest values. To embark on this quest, let us reflect on our journey—our dreams, encounters, and turning points. By peeling away the layers of our memories, we can unearth our true nature and discover our unfolding potential. Through this process, we can redefine our purpose as leaders, opening ourselves to a more meaningful and fulfilling life. Embracing our true selves allows us to significantly and authentically contribute to those we lead. Your story is how you explain how you experience the world to yourself. Leveraging that story offers you more powerful and imaginative choices as a leader and human being. It’s about transforming yourself to transform the world you are in. Rather than being led by circumstances, the core of our leading  calls us to lead from our hearts and deeper intention This is an inner journey. An experiential journey. Exploring your way forward together with our CMA faculty members.

26 Jan to 2 Feb 2024 I Nepal Trek: Stepping Into Your Hero Journey

Experience the transformative power of restoration, reconnection, and renewal as you journey to the awe-inspiring Himalayan mountains, and start the new year with a rejuvenated heart that is awakened and alive.

Click Here to download the schedule.

Based on the work of Joseph Campbell - A Hero's Journey, this is a 5 days guided group learning session where you can examine your own life and redefine who you want to be.

This will be a four-day trek at Ghorepani, Poonhill and Ghandruk, and the difficulty level is moderate, which is suitable for a beginner or someone with no trekking experience.

Rest is not idleness, and to lie sometimes on the grass under trees on a summer's day or watching the clouds float across the sky is by no means a waste of time. Sir John Lubbock

Estimated Fee: USD 1,200, including accommodation in Kathmandu and trekking expenditure.

20 - 22 May 2024 I Cyprus, Agia Napa, Faros Hotel

Retreat Fee: EUR 990

Including three nights accommodation + half-boarding [ breakfast and lunch ]
